title: ABA receipts
description: Where the ABA iPhone app sends a donation receipt when someone ends a block early, and where the developer's reply to it is written.
blast_radius: low — isolated to its own subdomain and runtime
rationale: Its own PocketBase datastore and nothing else: no outbound calls, no sign-in. The app sends receipts anonymously under a per-install key it keeps secret, reads back only its own, and the verdict and reply are written by the owner in the dashboard. The screenshots can show a donor's name or email, so they are protected files, never served without a token. One schedule: hourly, it deletes every receipt older than 24 hours, screenshot and all.
